content: The renowned classics scholar caused a stir when her critical review of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey went viral. Wilson explains her reaction to the film and why she's translating the poem again.

title: Greetings from an isolated region in northern Pakistan's Hindu Kush mountains
author: Betsy Joles
content: Chitral borders Afghanistan and isn't easy to reach. Breathtaking views abound in this remote mountainous region — as do rockslides and avalanches.

title: U.S. and Iran resume attacks. And, Fauci to face Senate questions on COVID pandemic
author: Brittney Melton
content: The U.S. and Iran have resumed fighting after Iran attacked U.S. forces in the Middle East yesterday. And, a Senate committee will question Anthony Fauci about the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: New York school pauses plan to deploy humanlike AI robot teacher after backlash
author: The Associated Press
content: A school district in upstate New York is pausing plans to deploy an AI-powered, humanoid robot in the classroom after state education officials, teachers and local residents raised concerns.

title: Iran resumes missile attacks as U.S. and Saudis strike Tehran-backed militias in Iraq
author: The Associated Press
content: The flare-up on multiple fronts raised the risk of a return to all-out war, underscoring the difficulty of winding down a five-month conflict that has jolted the world economy.

title: A divided Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady despite high inflation
author: Scott Horsley
content: The Federal Reserve left its benchmark interest rate unchanged Wednesday.  Fed policymakers say they remain committed to curbing stubborn inflation.
